notes.title: v1.1.0 - music, faster pacing, bug fixes, higher brightness, shields, fights
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added music to day 4-5
[*] All maps are now smaller to ensure a more engaging game pacing with less dull moments
[*] Shields are now inversed because it's more intuitive
[*] Small bug fixes
[*] Encounters are now more interesting - enemies are stacked together on day 2, enemies move a lot more on day 4
[/list]
